parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end timestamp of the alert logs to be queried.

Unit: milliseconds.

> 

*   You can query only the alert logs within the last year.

*   The interval between the start time (`StartTime`) and end time (`EndTime`) must be less than or equal to 15 days.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The type of the alert event. Valid values:

*   TRIGGERED: The alert is triggered.
*   RESOLVED: The alert is resolved.

parameters.name: GroupBy
parameters.description:
The dimensions based on which data is aggregated. This parameter is equivalent to the GROUP BY clause in SQL. Valid values:

*   `product`: aggregates data by cloud service.
*   `level`: aggregates data by alert level.
*   `groupId`: aggregates data by application group.
*   `contactGroup`: aggregates data by alert contact group.
*   `product,metricName`: aggregates data both by cloud service and by metric.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application group.

parameters.name: LastMin
parameters.description: The statistical period of alert logs. Unit: minutes.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The severity level and notification methods of the alert. Valid values:

*   P4: Alert notifications are sent by using emails and DingTalk chatbots.
*   OK: No alert is generated.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The metric name.

>  For more information about the metrics of different cloud services, see [Appendix 1: Metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

>  For more information about the namespaces of different cloud services, see [Appendix 1: Metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Product
parameters.description: The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert rule.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an alert rule, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the alert rule.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword that is used to query alert logs.

parameters.name: SendStatus
parameters.description:
The alert status. Valid values:

*   0: The alert is triggered or cleared.
*   1: The alert is ineffective.
*   2: The alert is muted and not triggered in a specified period.
*   3: The host is restarting.
*   4: No alert notification is sent.

If the value of the SendStatus parameter is 0, the value P4 of the Level parameter indicates a triggered alert and the value OK indicates a cleared alert.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start timestamp of the alert logs to be queried.

Unit: milliseconds.

> 

*   You can query only the alert logs within the last year.

*   The interval between the start time (`StartTime`) and end time (`EndTime`) must be less than or equal to 15 days.
